cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've locked both our bags away, just like the instructor. Leave them there while we discuss the climbing wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She was testing a broken lock. You've put our bags in a locker we can't open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, equipment checked. Ask her to release them after the safety talk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can wait through a safety talk. I'm not agreeing to climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. With the bags dealt with, put a harness on for the talk. Then you'll already be ready when they ask who wants a turn.
